full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white woodcut-like print depicts an imagined landscape of massive twisting trunks, rounded hills, sparse plants, and sharp rays of light. The upper-left opening glows white behind a single small dark bird in flight. From that opening, straight pale beams cut diagonally across the darker sky toward the center. Tall rock or tree forms at the far left press inward and create a shadowed foreground frame. Across the middle distance, a cluster of stepped dark structures rises on a ridge, partly hidden by rounded shrubs. A broad central trunk bends and branches across the top of the composition, its large arcs dividing the white openings into dramatic shapes. On the right, another huge curved form frames a deep black recess and a small pale block near the upper edge. In the lower half, rolling ground is built from overlapping elongated bands. Their crests are bright and their undersides black, giving the terrain the rhythm of folded fabric or carved waves. Small branching plants and spiky leaves punctuate the slopes, with a rounded canopy near the middle. At the bottom left, a narrow bright channel passes between dark banks before disappearing behind the ridges. The entire image is monochrome: bright uninked surfaces face dark inked cavities, and fine stippled or engraved marks soften only the transitions between them. Light seems to enter forcefully from the upper left, sending beams through the scene while casting the nearest vertical forms into deep shadow. No readable text appears. The overall composition is dense yet strongly directed, using sweeping curves, stepped silhouettes, and luminous diagonals to turn a landscape into a dramatic carved pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形木刻般的黑白版画描绘想象中的风景，由巨大的扭转树干、圆润山丘、稀疏植物和锐利光线组成。左上方开口在一只飞行的小深色鸟身后发出白光。几道笔直浅色光束从那里斜穿更深的天空，指向中央。最左侧高耸的岩石或树木形体向内压入，形成阴影中的前景框。中远处，一组阶梯状深色构筑物从山脊升起，部分藏在圆润灌木之后。一株宽大的中央树干弯曲并在构图顶部展开树枝，巨大弧线把白色开口分成戏剧性的形状。右侧另一道巨大的曲线围住深黑凹处及上缘附近的一小块浅色。下半部起伏地面由重叠的细长带状形体建立，凸起亮白，底面漆黑，让地形有如折布或雕刻波浪的节奏。细小分枝植物与尖叶点缀斜坡，中央附近有一簇圆润树冠。左下角一道狭窄亮色水道从深岸之间通过，又隐入山脊后方。整幅画面只有黑白：未上墨的亮面面对墨黑凹处，细微点刻或刻线仅在二者过渡处加以柔化。光似乎从左上方强烈进入，送出穿越场景的光束，同时让最近的竖向形体落入深影。没有可读文字。整体构图密集却方向鲜明，以扫过画面的曲线、阶梯剪影和发亮斜线把风景变成戏剧化的雕刻图案。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome relief-print treatment derives volume from an uncompromising opposition of white cuts and densely inked black. Fine stippling, engraved hatch marks, and pebbled grain grade the boundary between those extremes without turning it into a smooth gray wash. Broad curving bands overlap like carved layers, while sharp rays and narrow channels interrupt them with directional force. Large dark vertical masses frame smaller, more intricate middle-distance forms, giving the composition depth through scale and occlusion. Light is graphic and dramatic, entering through pale openings and leaving recesses almost entirely black. Repetition of arcs and short textured marks links every surface into one energetic pattern. No color weakens the tonal structure; even tiny details are organized around the major light-dark flow. The overall effect is monumental, mysterious, and tactile, with physical-looking cuts and sweeping geometry carrying the scene.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色凸版画处理从未上墨白色刻口与密实墨黑的强烈对立中建立体积。细点刻、雕刻排线和卵石般颗粒对两极之间的边界加以分级，却不把它们抹成平滑灰色晕染。宽阔曲带像雕出的层面般相互遮叠，锐利光束和狭窄通道则用方向性力量打断它们。深色竖向大形框住中距离较小且更繁复的形体，让尺度与遮挡建立纵深。光线图形化且富戏剧性，从浅色开口进入，让凹处几乎完全漆黑。弧线与短促肌理笔痕的重复把每处表面连成统一而有力的图案。没有色彩削弱明暗结构；即使细小细节也服从主要的黑白流动。整体效果宏伟、神秘且可触，实体般的刻口与扫过画面的几何线条承载场景。
theme_en: A stark black-and-white landscape of twisting trunks and radiating light
theme_zh: 扭曲树干与放射光线构成的黑白风景
name: Lynd Ward
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
